purpose: public-sequence validation of the radar-anchored fusion core under unique-pedestrian episodes
target_rule: Exactly one annotated pedestrian per retained frame. Other road users remain in the unmodified RGB and RA inputs.
selection_note: The four validation source sequences were fixed from annotation-only audit summaries to cover clear and distractor-present episodes across near, mid, and far pedestrian ranges. No localization model output or held-out metric was used for this assignment.
validation_role: Development validation only. This protocol has no CRUW held-out test partition and must not be described as an official CRUW/ROD2021 test or leaderboard result.
manual_review_required: Candidate runs remain pending manual continuity and visual-condition review before model training. Every candidate run from a source sequence inherits that source sequence split.
